guards: .windowed-views.json — every store view whose result depends on now() declares the window it carries and what a caller may compare across time instead

gates.stated: A figure compared over time is a trend only if the population is stable.

poisonPill.expectStderr: windowed view must declare its window
poisonPill.why: The declaration file with `unremediated_acceptances` removed — the state the repo was actually in on 2026-11-13, when its 116 -> 47 fall over five weeks was reported as a backlog being worked down. The two windows shared 0 rows and 110 of the 116 were still open. The pill drops the view whose own body names no clock (it inherits the window from `unremediated_acceptances_all`), so a gate that only grepped the migrations for now() would pass this fixture.
